sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Output and Logs
claimsUsed: For moderately populated NIRCam images, alignment should normally retain at least 100 matched stars with sigma below 0.30 pixels.
At least 100 stars per image are desirable for PSF measurement, and the absolute central-pixel PSF adjustment should remain below 0.05.
At least 100 stars per image are desirable for aperture correction.

sources.title: DOLPHOT JWST — Parameter Definitions
claimsUsed: JWST reductions require WCS-based alignment settings.
FitSky=2 is a robust sky-fitting mode for crowded fields.
PSF-star and aperture-correction outputs are quality-control artifacts rather than optional presentation details.

sources.title: NIRCam Field of View
claimsUsed: A NIRCam module has four short-wavelength detectors arranged in a two-by-two layout.
The short-wavelength detector footprints are separated by physical gaps, so a compact sky tile need not overlap all four detectors.

sources.title: DOLPHOT Stellar Photometry for JWST NIRCam and NIRISS Imaging
claimsUsed: DOLPHOT was validated for crowded-field photometry on calibrated JWST exposures.
PSF and aperture-correction mismatch can contribute approximately hundredth-magnitude systematics, while detector-dependent offsets can be larger.

sources.title: A Perfect Host for a Test of the Hubble Constant
claimsUsed: NGC 3447 contains two interacting components that support a differential Cepheid-distance comparison.
The published component comparison does not remove the need to validate target-specific flux recovery on native exposures.

factInferenceProposalBoundary.verifiedFacts: Instrument topology, software diagnostics, the 32 archived exposure identities, WCS footprint membership, and the real reference-run output are treated as facts only when independently parsed.
factInferenceProposalBoundary.inference: Classifying zero matches outside a detector's predeclared support as geometric non-overlap is an inference tested by exact agreement between WCS membership and DOLPHOT match rows.
factInferenceProposalBoundary.proposal: Running the remaining three detector tiles, enlarging failed calibration regions, and only then spending the sealed artificial-star rows remain proposed next actions.
